items.q: I run a lot. What's the cheapest way?
items.a: Drive a solo bus for maximum speed. If you want to go further, run several solo buses in parallel from scripts using an API key, and read per-bus cost from the dashboard. When headcount matters, pool with others — more riders, lower per head.

items.q: I only need it once in a while. Can I still hop on?
items.a: Yes. Pay per pull, no stockpile. Keys can stay with you, sync to your own pool, or be handed over as plaintext right after.

items.q: Pool or solo, how do I decide?
items.a: In a hurry, want a private pool, running batches → solo, throughput isn't shared. Daily use, price sensitive, don't mind waiting → pool, split by head, cheaper per head.

items.q: How many riders fit on one bus?
items.a: Up to five. You can start one and invite by pool code, or let the system match strangers. The driver can remove riders or adjust shares.

items.q: Do concurrency / RPM / TPM get contested between riders?
What happens when I run out of credits?
items.a: This round skips you — the bus keeps running, but you get no key. Three rounds in a row → the bus pauses you and stops billing your share. Top up and the next round auto-resumes. We recommend keeping 5–10 rounds worth in the wallet, or turning on auto top-up.
This round's credits aren't refunded — the key has already been pulled. From the next round on, you stop being billed and stop receiving new keys. Keys you already got are yours.

items.q: Can I share my own key into a bus?
items.a: Yes. Push a key you already have into a bus and other riders can use it. Every use returns 1:1 credit to your wallet — as much credit as they consume, you get back. Idle quota becomes credit, and the bus gets cheaper for everyone.

items.q: What if a vendor is down, expensive, or out of stock?
items.a: We watch many vendors and rank by stability and effective cost (price ÷ average lifespan). If the chosen one has trouble, we switch to another. No script changes, no watching.

items.q: If a key dies mid-use, is credit refunded?
items.a: If it dies inside the warranty window, we pull a replacement and refund the used credit pro rata. Every refund and refill fires a webhook.

items.q: Where does my key data live? Can I take it?
items.a: Three destinations: stay in the bus, push to your own pool (URL + token in settings), or extract plaintext right into your hand — we delete our copy right after. Usage ledger is exportable from your dashboard.

items.q: How much does it actually cost?
items.a: Vendor key price, one service fee from us, and the payment gateway's own fee (pass-through). Every line is on your wallet page. Billed in USD, 1 credit ≈ $0.14.
